title: Havenline storage, buy and activation plots: combined final 29-sheet independent visual review
review_type: Independent actual-image review; selected assets and scores preserved from core and additive ledgers
gate_rule: Every selected sheet strictly above 9.0 and all applicable visual/source-boundary checks passed. No failed or unseen visual areas averaged away.
scope: 29 static plot concept sheets: 26 eight-view turnarounds and 3 state plates. No native meshes, motion, runtime integration, exact action/economy or capacity certification.

All 23 turnarounds inspected through eight clockwise directions; fixed major features and broad whole-pad yaw coherent after targeted repairs. Minor illustration projection variation is not a metric camera certificate.
Prior material identities retained; 12 unseen storage variants remain proposals; all 33 prior resources mapped as visual families only.
Source prices labelled reference examples; state quantities labelled illustrative with no capacity implied; no invented durations or inventory rules.

Independent critic examined actual full sheets and useful original/repair closeups. All selected scores exceed 9.0; no blocked or unseen visual checks remain.
All 33 earlier selected PNG hashes unchanged; all reviewed candidates and revision reports retained. Archive/GitHub publication is packaging owner's next gate, outside this image approval.
Three distinct additional source crops directly inspected; neutral glyph names and source example prices retained.

Core26 exact selected paths, hashes, scores, ledger and bound source/review files preserved unchanged.
